unit.title: Pushes and Pulls
unit.blurb: Pushing and pulling make things move, speed up, slow down, stop or change direction.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Know that pushes and pulls make things move.

O2.t: Know that a push or pull can make something go faster, slower or change direction.

p: A **push** moves something away from you. A **pull** moves something towards you. You push a door to close it and pull a drawer to open it.
Ask: is it moving away from me (push) or towards me (pull)?

q.prompt: You kick a ball. Is that a push or a pull?

options.fb: Kicking moves the ball away from you.

q.prompt: You open a drawer. Is that a push or a pull?

req.prompt: Is each one a push or a pull?
Which word means: move something away from you?
req.reason: Push means move something away from you.

options.fb: Force means a push or a pull.
Move means go from one place to another.

req.reason: Check every picture: close a door is push, kick a ball is push, tug of war is pull, open a drawer is pull.

vocab.def: go from one place to another

p: A bigger push makes a ball go **faster** and further. A push against a moving ball can make it **slow down** or **stop**. A push from the side makes it **change direction**.

lesson.q: Push a toy car three times: gently, a bit harder, very hard. What happens?

q.prompt: Which push makes a toy car go further: a gentle push or a big push?

options.fb: A bigger push makes it go further.
A gentle push only moves it a little.

q.prompt: A goalkeeper stops a ball. What did the push do?

options.fb: A push cannot change the size of a ball.

req.prompt: Which word means: not moving any more?
req.reason: Stop means not moving any more.

req.prompt: Put the pushes in order: the car goes least far first.
req.reason: No push: the car stays still. A gentle push: it moves a little. A hard push: it goes furthest.

req.prompt: Which push makes a swing go highest?

options.fb: A tiny push moves it only a little.
Without a push it stays still.
